battle.name: 太原之戰
battle.brief: 宣和七年冬，金西路左副元帥完顏宗翰自大同南下，靖康元年正月十五日合圍太原府晉陽城。姚括、張理由與王稟憑城固守，金人穴地、架雲梯、擲飛石，攻二百五十餘日不下；次年八月金人再至，盡殲姚古、种師中援軍，九月廿一日城破。卡面十字弩非宋軍實配，宋人守城所恃為神臂弓與床子弩，原理同源。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是金與北宋。金是完顏氏女真於一一一五年建立的政權，宣和七年（一一二五年）金太宗完顏吳乞買坐鎮會寧，下令以追究燕京歸宋的張覺事變為名，分東、西兩路大舉南侵：東路以晉國公完顏宗望領兵自平州攻燕山府，戰線在今河北中部；西路以左副元帥完顏宗翰領兵自西京大同南下，循代州、朔州而趨河東太原。西路軍的骨幹是女真猛安謀克騎兵，配契丹、渤海與漢人降兵，並有原遼籍漢人民兵組成的義勝軍十數萬人隨軍；金人連下朔州、代州之後，太原遂成孤城。宋方是完整的北宋軍政體系下的河東一線：河東路太原府知府姚括、統兵官張理由領晉陽守軍，樞密使童貫在城而先走，總制將官王稟以隨機應變拒敵於城下；西面有熙河經略使姚古、秦鳳經略使种師中兩支精銳為入援主力，東面由河北沿線各府州軍與東京留守司的援軍牽制，樞密院掌兵籍與調發，軍器監與各作坊供應弓弩與攻城之具。太原是河東的樞紐，控扼井陘、雁門一線的出入，一旦失守，河北與關中的兩支宋軍便要同時暴露在金騎面前。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were Jin and the Northern Song. Jin was the polity the Wanyan clan of the Jurchen had founded in 1115; in the seventh year of Xuanhe, 1125, the Taizong Wanyan Wuqimai sat at Huining and ordered a general invasion of Song on two fronts, using the affair of Zhang Jue, who had handed the territory of Yanjing to the Song, as the stated grievance. The eastern column, led by the Duke of Jin Wanyan Zongwang, set out from Pingzhou against Yanshan fu, its line running through the middle of present-day Hebei; the western column, led by the Left Deputy Commander-in-chief Wanyan Zonghan, came down from Xijing, Datong, and moved on Taiyuan through Dai and Shuo. The backbone of the western army was Jurchen meng'an mouke cavalry, supported by Khitan, Bohai and Han troops from the surrendered, together with some hundred thousand men of the yisheng army, Han militia raised from the former Liao population. Once Shuo and Dai had fallen, Taiyuan became an isolated city. On the Song side stood the northern line of a complete Northern Song military-administrative system: the governor of Taiyuan fu in Hedong lu, Yao Kuo, and the commander of the garrison, Zhang Youli, led the defenders of Jinyang, while the Privy Commissioner Tong Guan was in the city and ran away first, and the general Wang Beng with his talent for adapting to circumstance held the enemy off below the walls. On the western approach the two fine columns of Yao Gu, the commander of the Xihe circuit, and Zhong Shizhong, the commander of the Qinfeng circuit, came to relieve the city; on the east the armies of the prefectures along Hebei and the troops of the capital's resident office were engaged in screening the enemy, while the Privy Council held the rolls of soldiers and the dispatch, and the Directorate of Armaments and the workshops supplied bows, crossbows and siege tools. Taiyuan was the hinge of Hedong, commanding the entries at Jingxing and Yanmen; once it fell, the two Song armies of Hebei and of the passes would lie exposed to the Jin horse at the same time.
people: 金方主持這場圍城的是西路左副元帥完顏宗翰，即金人稱的粘罕。他以大同為基地，先取朔州、代州，再直趨晉陽；圍城之後，又留部將完顏婁室率五萬人繼續困守太原，主帥本人則抽兵南下，趕上第一次圍汴京的行動。完顏希尹與完顏婁室輪流督師於潼關外，專以截斷宋朝西軍的東來之路為務；漢人謀主高慶裔、時立愛在軍中參贊。東路的完顏宗望自平州一路攻破燕山府、中山、真定、信德，是為金人第一次南下的另一支拳頭。宋方守太原的是知府姚括與統兵官張理由，《金史》《宋史》都記二人拒守不降；名將王稟以隨機應變著稱，統制河北兵，於城下抵擋金人，童貫則先棄城南走。為太原入援的熙河經略使姚古、秦鳳經略使种師中領西軍，是宋廷倚重的精銳，結果在文水一線遭金騎全殲，兩人皆死於軍中。守將張灝在文水出戰亦潰。此戰的見證者與記錄者是密州安丘人陳規，他隨西軍轉戰各處，事後把太原、楚州、潭州一類城池的守備與攻城器用寫成《守城錄》，成為後世城防的圭臬。
peopleEn: The siege on the Jin side was directed by the Left Deputy Commander-in-chief Wanyan Zonghan, called Nihan by the Jin themselves. He used Datong as his base, took Shuo and Dai, and then drove straight for Jinyang; after the investment began he left the general Wanyan Louzhi with fifty thousand men to continue the blockade, while the commander himself detached a part of the army to march south and join the first investment of Bianjing. Wanyan Xiyin and Wanyan Louzhi took turns supervising operations outside the Tong Pass, their business being to cut off the western Song army's road east; the Han strategists Gao Qingyi and Shi Lian gave counsel in the camp. On the eastern front Wanyan Zongwang marched from Pingzhou and broke Yanshan fu, Zhongshan, Zhending and Xinde, the other fist of Jin's first invasion. On the Song side, the city of Taiyuan was held by the governor Yao Kuo and the commander of the garrison Zhang Youli, both of whom the History of Jin and the History of Song record as refusing to surrender; the famous general Wang Beng, known for adapting to circumstance, commanded the troops of Hebei and held the enemy off below the walls, while Tong Guan ran south and left first. The relief of Taiyuan was to be carried by Yao Gu of the Xihe circuit and Zhong Shizhong of the Qinfeng circuit with the western army, the finest troops the Song court relied upon; they were annihilated by the Jin horse on the line of Wenshui and both died in the field. The commander Zhang Hao was likewise routed when he fought at Wenshui. The witness and recorder of this campaign was Chen Gui of Anqiu in Mizhou, who served with the western armies as they campaigned across the north and afterwards wrote the defence of Taiyuan, Chuzhou and Tanzhou, together with the tools of assault and defence, into the Shoucheng lu, which became the standard manual of the fortified city for later generations.
kits: 卡面是十字弩：弩臂、機關與踏板把張弦的力氣交給機械，射程與破甲力都勝過長弓，代價是裝填緩慢，一旦離開掩體便難以續射。約在公元一一零零年前後，十字弩已是諾曼與十字軍部隊的標準裝備，弩手往往編在攻城的機械隊與守城的固定射位上，一具踏板弩要人踩上弩身才能上弦，射後須退回掩體重新裝填——這正是它同宋人床子弩、神臂弩的共同處。太原之戰的城頭上並沒有西歐式的手持弩，宋軍的機械化射擊以神臂弓為主：弓長三尺五寸，矢長一尺八寸，射程約二百四十步，能穿重甲；床子弩架在固定弩床上，上下各有望山，一人可以操縱，供城頭與野外部署。此外還有蹶張弩與步弩，各有專職的弓弩手營編制，與長弓手分列城頭垛口。除射擊兵器外，晉陽守軍備有撞竿、拒馬、鐵蒺藜、竹竿與皮網以拒雲梯，用火箭與火矢焚燒梯具與攻城器械，並有霹靂砲一類的爆炸物封堵地道；陳規《守城錄》所錄的攻器則包括雲梯、撞車、飛石與甕炮，金人所用投石之具是否已屬配重式的回回砲，史料記載不一，姑存疑。金軍的裝備體系正相反：女真騎兵結重甲而射擊精準，強弓強弩百張齊射，攻城則靠穴地、雲梯、撞車與投石，器械多屬臨時製造、數量有限。
kitsEn: The card shows a crossbow: a stock, a lock and a stirrup that hand the draw over to the machine, giving it greater range and better armour-piercing than a longbow at the cost of a slow reload, so that once it leaves cover it cannot keep up its fire. By about the year 1100 the crossbow was standard equipment in Norman and crusader forces, the crossbow men being posted with the engine companies of an assault and in the fixed firing positions of a defence, a stirrup crossbow having to be trodden down to be cocked and had to be drawn back into cover to be loaded again after the shot; that is precisely what it has in common with the bed crossbow and the shenbi bow of the Song. No Western hand crossbow stood on the parapet of Taiyuan: the mechanical shooting of the Song army rested on the shenbi bow, three feet five inches in the bow with a bolt of a foot eight inches, out to some two hundred and forty paces and able to pierce heavy armour, while the bed crossbow sat on a fixed frame with an upper and a lower sight and could be worked by a single man, issued for the wall and for field deployment. There were also the juzhang crossbow and the foot crossbow, each with its own specialist units of bow and crossbow hands posted on the parapet beside the longbowmen. Besides the missile weapons, the garrison of Jinyang carried pikes, cheval-de-frise, iron caltrops, bamboo poles and hide nets against ladders, fired rockets and fire arrows to burn the ladders and the siege engines, and had explosive devices of the thunder-shaking kind to seal the mines. The attacking tools listed by Chen Gui in the Shoucheng lu include ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers and the pot-mortar; whether the stone-throwing engines of the Jin were already counterweight trebuchets of the hui-hui type is not equally well attested, and the point may be left open. The Jin equipment system ran the other way: Jurchen cavalry fought in heavy armour with accurate shooting, strong bows and strong crossbows fired in files of a hundred, and the siege was carried by mining, ladders, rams and stone-throwers, most of them made up on the spot and few in number.
tactics: 金人打太原，用的是圍城加打援的兩手。圍城一面，穴地掘道攻門，雲梯數十架同時靠城，梯頂以長刀砍擊垛口，壕溝被土石與屍體填平，填土兵直衝城門，撞車撞擊門扇，同時以投石之具壓制城頭守軍；一面以騎兵遮斷城郊道路，使援軍不能靠近。第一次圍城歷時二百五十餘日而不下，金人遂罷兵南趨，恰好趕上第一次圍汴京，促成宣和和議。第二次，金人先打援軍：靖康元年八月底宗翰自大同出發，九月初六日破宋張灝軍於文水，隨即全殲姚古、种師中兩路西軍，援軍既滅，孤城更孤，九月廿一日城破。城破之後，完顏婁室抽部分兵力南渡黃河，西趨洛陽、封鎖潼關，把宋朝最精銳的西軍關在關內，這一步反過來決定了第二次汴京之役的結局。守城方的部署是分層的：城頭前列以撞竿與竹竿頂住雲梯，後列以神臂弓覆射城下密集之敵，弩手伏於垛口，以床子弩與長弓交叉射擊，火箭與火矢專射攻城器械與穴地火把，斥候與敢死隊在夜間出城焚燒攻城器、修補被毀的城垛。問題出在體制與補給：勤王兵分屬數十路，無統一指揮，糧餉不繼，援軍屢集屢潰，孤城撐過二百五十餘日，靠的是城本身的堅固與守軍的膽氣，而不是任何一件兵器的威力。
tacticsEn: The Jin attacked Taiyuan with two hands at once: a blockade and an attack on the relief. On the side of the blockade they drove mines under the gate, brought up several dozen ladders at the same time so that the men at the top could cut at the parapet with long blades, filled the ditch with earth, stone and bodies so that the men who followed could run at the gate over the fill, and rammed the doors with battering rams while stone-throwing engines kept down the defenders on the wall. On the other hand they used cavalry to close the roads outside the city so that no relief could come near. The first investment lasted more than two hundred and fifty days and did not take the city; the Jin then withdrew to march south, arriving in time for the first siege of Bianjing and giving the Xuanhe settlement its occasion. The second time the Jin went after the relief first: at the end of the eighth month of Jingkang Zonghan set out from Datong, on the sixth day of the ninth month he broke Zhang Hao's troops at Wenshui, and then annihilated the two western columns of Yao Gu and Zhong Shizhong; with the relief destroyed the lone city was lonelier still, and on the twenty-first day of the ninth month the city fell. After the fall Wanyan Louzhi detached part of his force, crossed the Yellow River to the south, moved west on Luoyang and sealed the Tong Pass, shutting the finest of the Song armies inside it; that single move in turn decided the outcome of the second siege of Bianjing. The defence was arranged in tiers: at the front of the wall pikes and bamboo poles were used to hold off the ladders, behind them the shenbi bows swept the crowded enemy below, the crossbow men lay at the parapets and crossed their fire with the bed crossbows and the longbows, rockets and fire arrows were kept for the siege engines and for the torches of the miners, and scouts and volunteers went out at night to burn the attacking gear and to repair the parapets shot away. The trouble lay in organisation and supply: the relief troops belonged to dozens of commands with no unified command and no common supply, they gathered and were beaten again and again, and the lone city held for more than two hundred and fifty days on the strength of the walls and of the garrison's nerve, not of the power of any single weapon.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力、圍城日數與議和條件三處。金西路軍初出時與東路同為六萬餘人，經長期圍攻太原，兵力不斷補充，總數增加一倍有餘；第二次攻宋時東西兩路合計超過十五萬，比第一次增加約一倍半，其中封鎖潼關者五萬，參加第二次圍汴京者尚有七八萬；完顏婁室率五萬金軍專圍太原。圍攻歷時二百五十餘日；第一次圍汴京歷三十三日，第二次自十一月二十五日被圍至同日午時陷落，亦約一月。宣和和議的價碼是金五百萬兩、銀五千萬兩、牛馬萬匹、衣緞百萬疋，並割太原、中山、河間三鎮，以宰相與親王為質；宋廷在期限內解出金二十餘萬兩、銀四百餘萬兩，已把京城搜刮殆盡。第一次圍汴京時，東京禁軍加上陸續開到的勤王兵，號稱二三十萬，第二次圍城時城內守軍不滿七萬。太原以孤城當五萬大軍，守將王稟之能、姚括與張理由之守，拖住了西路軍的全部時程；同樣的西軍，第二次卻在文水一線被殲，兩次對照正是此戰最能說明的地方。器械尺度方面，陳規《守城錄》所記神臂弓弓長三尺五寸、矢長一尺八寸，可與同時代弩機的規格互相對照。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked cluster in three places: numbers of men, numbers of days, and the terms of the settlement. The western Jin column went out with the same strength as the eastern, a little over sixty thousand men; after the long investment of Taiyuan its numbers were continually reinforced and grew by more than half again. On the second invasion the two columns together exceeded one hundred and fifty thousand, about one and a half times the first, of whom fifty thousand were to seal the Tong Pass and seventy or eighty thousand still took part in the second siege of Bianjing; Wanyan Louzhi led fifty thousand men in the blockade of Taiyuan itself. The investment lasted more than two hundred and fifty days. The first siege of Bianjing lasted thirty-three days; the second, from the investment on the twenty-fifth day of the eleventh month to the fall of the city at noon of the same day, was also about a month. The price of the Xuanhe settlement was five million taels of gold, fifty million taels of silver, ten thousand head of cattle and horses and one million bolts of silk, together with the cession of Taiyuan, Zhongshan and Hejian and the handing over of a chancellor and a prince as hostages; the Song court delivered a little over two hundred thousand taels of gold and more than four million taels of silver within the term, leaving the capital picked clean. Before the first siege of Bianjing the imperial guards of the eastern capital together with the relief armies still coming up from the north-west were numbered at two or three hundred thousand, whereas at the second siege the garrison inside the city was short of seventy thousand. A lone city stood against fifty thousand men, and the ability of Wang Beng, the steadfastness of Yao Kuo and Zhang Youli, held up the whole course of the western column; the same western army was annihilated in a single afternoon on the line of Wenshui, and the contrast between the two occasions is the most instructive thing about this campaign. As for the scale of the equipment, the shenbi bow recorded in the Shoucheng lu of Chen Gui, three feet five inches in the bow with a bolt of a foot eight inches, can be set beside the specifications of the crossbow mechanism of the same age.
cause: 打起來的原因是三層。最外層是海上之盟的後果與張覺事變：北宋聯金滅遼，金得燕雲十六州而宋僅以錢贖回空城，盟約從此無一是信；宣和七年，宋廷趁遼人內變招納燕京地區的遼將張覺，接收幽州之地，金人藉此口實，指宋違約，兩路南侵。中層是金廷的戰略轉向：金太宗完顏吳乞買在完顏阿骨打之後改採攻勢，認定宋廷軍弱財廣，取河東、河北之地即可直逼汴京；金人志在滅宋，並不只取燕雲。最內層是北宋自身的崩解：王黼、蔡攸、童貫一類人把持朝政，禁軍空額極多、久未操演，軍器與工匠缺乏，和平日久無人知兵；而河東一線的形勢又格外險惡：原遼籍漢人組成的義勝軍十數萬人降金，朔州、代州相繼開城，太原一舉成了懸在河東的孤城，宋廷即使發兵入援，也要先在沒有援兵的地方打一場。
causeEn: The war came out of three layers. The outermost was the consequence of the alliance made at sea and of the affair of Zhang Jue: the Northern Song had joined with Jin to destroy the Liao, Jin took the sixteen prefectures of Yan and Yun while the Song bought back empty cities with silver, and not one term of the alliance was honoured afterwards; in the seventh year of Xuanhe the Song court took advantage of the trouble in the Liao and took over the Liao general Zhang Jue with the land of Youzhou, and the Jin used this as the pretext for a breach of the covenant and for the two-pronged invasion. The middle layer was the strategic turn of the Jin court: after the death of Wanyan Aguda the Taizong Wanyan Wuqimai took the offensive, judged that the Song court was weak in war and rich in treasure, and reasoned that taking Hedong and Hebei would bring the army straight to Bianjing; Jin's object was the destruction of Song, not the recovery of Yan and Yun. The innermost layer was the collapse of the Northern Song itself: men of the type of Wang Fu, Cai You and Tong Guan held the government, the imperial guards were largely empty on the rolls and long untrained, arms and craftsmen were scarce, and a long peace had left nobody who knew the business of war. The situation on the Hedong line was exceptionally bad as well: some hundred thousand men of the yisheng army, Han militia raised from the former Liao population, went over to Jin, the gates of Shuo and Dai were opened in turn, and Taiyuan became at one stroke an isolated city hanging in Hedong; even with relief sent out, the Song had first to fight a battle in a place where no relief could reach them.
impact: 太原的陷落，動搖的是北宋整個北邊的結構。第一，宣和和議已把太原、中山、河間三鎮割與金，山西從此成了金人的內地，宋朝只剩河北與關中兩條線，兩地之間再沒有可以互相照應的據點；金人此後得以在河東設軍置吏，把山西的鐵、馬匹與人丁納入自己的軍資。第二，完顏婁室封鎖潼關，把宋朝精銳的西軍關在關內，東出的勤王之路斷絕，第二次汴京之役因此再無援兵可恃，最終導致靖康之難與北宋的覆亡。第三，技術與知識層面的收穫由宋人自己留下：陳規據親歷所寫的《守城錄》，把晉陽守城所用的神臂弓、床子弩、撞竿、拒馬與霹靂砲一類器用逐一記錄，後來成為南宋城防的教科書，弩手與撞竿配合、火箭焚梯的守城套路由此定型。第四，十字弩這類西方技術在十二世紀仍是歐洲攻城與守城的中堅，兩地的弩兵都只在城頭與固定射位上發揮作用，取向相近而器材迥異，這場戰役留下的不只是失地。
impactEn: The fall of Taiyuan shook the whole structure of the Song north. First, the Xuanhe settlement had already ceded Taiyuan, Zhongshan and Hejian to Jin, and Shanxi from that moment was interior country for the Jin; the Song retained only two lines, in Hebei and in the passes, with no post left between them where one could support the other. Jin could henceforth station troops and set up administration in Hedong, and draw the iron, the horses and the people of Shanxi into its own war supply. Second, Wanyan Louzhi's sealing of the Tong Pass shut the finest Song armies inside it and cut the road by which relief could come east; the second siege of Bianjing was therefore left without the help it needed, and out of that came the Disaster of Jingkang and the end of the Northern Song. Third, the gain in craft and in knowledge was left by the Song themselves: the Shoucheng lu, which Chen Gui wrote from his own experience, records item by item the shenbi bow, the bed crossbow, the pike, the cheval-de-frise and the thunder-shaking bomb used in the defence of Jinyang, and it became the manual of the fortified city for the southern Song, fixing the pattern by which crossbow and pike worked together and rockets burned the ladders. Fourth, such a Western device as the crossbow remained in the twelfth century a mainstay of European siege and defence, and on both sides the crossbow men were of use only on the walls and in the fixed firing positions; the two peoples were alike in their approach and unalike in their gear, and what this campaign left behind was not only lost ground.
result: 結果分兩截。第一次：靖康元年正月十五日金人合圍晉陽，太原不下，攻至二百五十餘日，粘罕得知東路已與宋議和，遂罷兵；太原為西路軍拖住的時程，反過來讓汴京有了談判的機會，宣和和議因此成立。第二次：靖康元年八月庚戌，完顏宗翰再自大同出發，九月初六日破宋張灝軍於文水，全殲姚古、种師中兩路援軍，九月廿一日克太原，城破；完顏婁室即抽兵南渡黃河，徑趨洛陽、封鎖潼關，十月自太原南下，十一月與東路會師汴京，閏十一月二十五日汴京城破，徽、欽二帝被俘北去，北宋亡。太原的陷落沒有替金人贏下整場戰爭——東路第一次攻汴京同樣無功——卻把金人西路最難的一段路打通了，此後金軍再沒有在河東遇到過同等規模的抵抗；而守住晉陽二百五十餘日的姚括、張理由與王稟，其功在當時的論賞中未獲相稱的肯定，戰後追議頗有爭議，太原遂成金人南下中原的第一塊敲開的磚。
resultEn: The result came in two parts. The first: on the fifteenth day of the first month of Jingkang the Jin closed round Jinyang, and Taiyuan did not fall; after more than two hundred and fifty days of assault, and once Nihan learned that the eastern column had already made terms with the Song, he broke off. The time the western column was held at Taiyuan gave Bianjing its chance to negotiate, and the Xuanhe settlement was made. The second: on the gengxu day of the eighth month of Jingkang Wanyan Zonghan set out from Datong again, on the sixth day of the ninth month he broke Zhang Hao's troops at Wenshui and annihilated the two relief columns of Yao Gu and Zhong Shizhong, and on the twenty-first day of the ninth month he took Taiyuan and the city fell. Wanyan Louzhi then detached troops to cross the Yellow River and move on Luoyang and seal the Tong Pass; in the tenth month the western column marched south from Taiyuan, in the eleventh it joined the eastern column before Bianjing, and on the twenty-fifth day of the intercalary eleventh month the city fell, the two emperors were taken and marched north, and the Northern Song perished. The loss of Taiyuan did not win the whole war for Jin, since the eastern column had failed as well before Bianjing, but it opened the hardest stretch of the western road, and the Jin armies met no resistance in Hedong of that scale again. And those who had held Jinyang for more than two hundred and fifty days, Yao Kuo, Zhang Youli and Wang Beng, saw their service rated at the time in no way adequate to their merit, the later reckoning of the case remaining disputed; Taiyuan became the first stone knocked out of the wall by the Jin on their way into the central plain.
